purpose: Collect quick audience preference feedback and optionally display poll results.
confirmations: Thank voter; show or hide result according to approved setting.
notifications: Optional internal notification if moderation or editorial follow-up is needed.
feeds: Polls Add-On result handling only; avoid using poll results as high-stakes decision evidence.
embedding_target: Article/sidebar/page embed; validate block/shortcode display and duplicate embed risk.
data_retention_notes: May include IP/session metadata and optional comments. Do not call anonymous if identifying fields or tracking IDs are collected.
risks: Public results can influence later responses.
Cache/CDN may affect stale result display.
Polls are not high-integrity voting systems by default.

spam_settings.recommended: Use layered spam protection appropriate for public feedback forms.

accessibility_settings.labels: Visible labels required. Scale choices need plain-language labels.
